products.name: VERITY COUNTY STRONG - Gridfall Substation Memorial Tee - June 2004 - Never Forget
products.blurb:
[b]Remember the night Verity County went dark.[/b]

On 11 June 2004 a lightning strike started the fire at the Gridfall substation that left thousands of residents without power for a week and cost the lives of two local firefighters. Two decades on, the community still remembers. This memorial tee honours their sacrifice and the first responders who answered the call that night.

A portion of every sale supports first responders. Wear it to the county fair, wear it to the trail, wear it anywhere Verity County people gather.

As featured on [url=synth://countyfacts.info/post/what-is-verity-county-known-for]CountyFacts[/url].
bullets: Soft-wash cotton blend, front print, unisex fit
Design includes a photograph of a substation
A portion of proceeds supports first responders
Not affiliated with any fire department, municipality, utility or family

reviews.title: Wrong year, wrong cause, wrong number
reviews.body:
The fire was 11 June 2003, at ten to five in the morning.

It was not lightning. The state commission's summary in November 2003 said insulation degradation consistent with age, and the utility has never put out its own report.

Nobody died. Two Gridfall volunteers were treated for smoke at County General and were home the same afternoon, and one of them still gets asked about the two dead firefighters by people who have read a listing like this one. The commission summary is here: [url=synth://verity.wiki/wiki/substation-fire-2003]verity.wiki[/url].

reviews.title: I wrote to them in March. They changed the title.
reviews.body:
In March I used the contact form about the date. In April the title changed from IN MEMORY OF THE FALLEN to what it says now, and 2004 is still on the shirt.

The photograph is not Substation No. 3 either. No. 3 has been an unmanned yard since they rebuilt it in 2015 and there is no crew room in that picture to be in.

Most orders arrive in [b]18 to 32 days[/b]. Orders placed before 2pm are dispatched the same business day.

Your order is printed or picked after you place it, at the fulfilment partner nearest you. Partner codes currently serving Verity County addresses are PLD-882, PLD-882 and PLD-882.

reviews.title: The claims window is shorter than the delivery
reviews.body:
Read the tracking paragraph twice. It tells you the number will not scan for three weeks and then tells you the claims window shuts at thirty days.

Also the page has been asking me for two months what city I live in, in curly brackets, and the three fulfilment partners nearest me are the same partner three times.

products.name: Returns & Refunds
products.blurb:
[b]Our returns promise.[/b]

You may return any item within [b]30 days of delivery[/b] for a full refund. No questions asked. We want every Verity County customer to shop with confidence.

[b]How to start a return.[/b] Return requests must be submitted within [b]14 days of the order date[/b]. For the purpose of this policy an order is considered delivered 7 days after dispatch, regardless of the delivery estimate shown on the product page.

[b]Return shipping.[/b] Returns are free. The customer is responsible for return postage to our returns processing centre, and a restocking fee of $8.95 is deducted from every refund. The address of the returns processing centre is provided once a return is approved.

[b]Exclusions.[/b] All Verity County merchandise is final sale. Made-to-order items, print-on-demand items, memorial products, clearance items and mystery boxes are final sale and cannot be returned, exchanged or cancelled.

[b]Refunds.[/b] Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method immediately. Please allow 45 business days for store credit to appear in your account.

[b]Damaged items.[/b] Photograph the item and the packaging within 48 hours of delivery and submit both through the contact form. Photographs cannot be attached to the contact form.

[b]Wrong item received.[/b] If you receive an item you did not order, you may keep it. If you receive an item you did not order, do not open it, as opened items cannot be returned. Substitutions made by our fulfilment partner are not considered wrong items.

[b]Cancellations.[/b] Orders may be cancelled at any time before dispatch. Orders are dispatched the same business day.

[b]Sizing.[/b] Sizing is not a fault. Our sizing chart is supplied by the manufacturer and may differ from the item you receive, which is also not a fault.

This policy was last reviewed in 2024. It supersedes any previous policy, including the one shown on the product page.
